name: Leos
source:
Strengths - Calculating, convincing, nearly perfect at his job
Weaknesses - Hotheaded, secretive, his noticeable hair color

Leos lives on the outskirts of Aurelia Cavella, very differently to Raen. 
Trained alone since a young age, he spends most of his time stalking around town in the shadows. He's only ever sought after if someone requires his particular set of skills.

He typically prefers to work alone. No matter what, Leos doesn't want to rely on or get close to anyone else, since it would leave a weakness for others to exploit.

Likes to tease Fawn, hates being teased by Cyne.

[From the developer's [url=https://twitter.com/TwoHalfStudios/status/1099171407848660993/]official Twitter[/url]]
